單項式理想 Hilbert 級數演算法 HP
Lezama et al., Ore and Goldie theorems for skew PBW extensions
skew PBW 廣義 Hilbert 級數可計算
Giesbrecht, On Factoring Quantum-Plane Skew Polynomials over Q(ω)(t)
中心界／gcrd 分割／兩層模組分解
Ore extension xr = σ(r)x + δ(r), δ(rs)=δ(r)s+σ(r)δ(s)
Ore 環為自由右 R-模
Gómez-Torrecillas–Lobillo–Navarro, Computing the bound of an Ore polynomial
bound 快速演算法與不可約判準
deg lclm = deg f + deg g − deg gcrd
Brent–Kung, Fast Algorithms for Manipulating Formal Power Series
composition ≡ reversion, Newton O(M(n) log n)
Johansson, A fast algorithm for reversion of power series
Lagrange 反演常數因子改進
Zhang / Pratt, Chu spaces, concept lattices, event-state duality
完備格表示與 Chu 對偶
Lovász / EKR, Kneser graph chromatic & independence numbers
閉包算子格、約束與平行探索
Giesbrecht, On Factoring Quantum-Plane Skew Polynomials over Q(ω)(t) (CASC 2026)
中心 C=K(t^m)[x^m]；monic central bound 由線性代數計算；gcrd 分割；T↦a 特殊化後 inert prime 降到有限域，Caruso–Le Borgne 分解、插值提升、精確右除驗證；代數閉包上可判定
Ding–Wang–Xiao–Zheng, An Algorithm for Computing GCRD of Parametric Ore Polynomials (ISSAC'24)
定義 Ore Sylvester 矩陣；非參數時行階梯形式直接得 gcrd；參數時以模組 Gröbner 基底求參數 gcrd；Singular 實作
Caruso–Le Borgne, A new faster algorithm for factoring skew polynomials over finite fields
reduced norm N: k[X;σ]→k^σ[X^r]、Azumaya 代數；快速乘法／除法／擴展歐幾里得；§3.2.2 rgcd 與 llcm；SkewFactorization 平均 Õ(d r³ log q + …)
Beckermann–Labahn, Fraction-free Row Reduction of Matrices of Ore Polynomials
無分式列消去求左零空間／weak Popov form，同時得 GCRD 與 LCLM；與 subresultants 聯繫
Puchinger–Wachter-Zeh, Fast Operations on Linearized Polynomials
skew 多項式次二次乘法、q-transform、多點求值／插值、Gabidulin 解碼
Lyu, Complete Factorization of Skew-Polynomials over Finite Fields
KaratsubaSkew 遞迴：低次用 Giesbrecht、高次 3 次半尺寸乘法，O(n^1.58 t^1.41)
Kriegel–Borchmann, NextClosures: Parallel Computation of the Canonical Base (CLA 2015)
NextClosure 本質序列（lectic）無法平行；改以基數遞增層級枚舉 intents/pseudo-intents，同層候選獨立、無需通訊，speedup ∝ CPU 數
Kriegel, NextClosures with Constraints / Parallel Attribute Exploration (CLA/ICCS 2016)
閉包算子構成完備格；約束為第二閉包算子 φ⋎ψ；quasi-rank 函數；Algorithm 1 每層候選平行處理；約束不相容時平行探索不可行
Kinoshita–Li, Power Series Composition in Near-Linear Time (FOCS 2024)
基於 Bostan–Mori Graeffe 迭代與轉置原理；任意交換環上 O(M(n) log m + M(m))；改進 Kedlaya–Umans 與 NSSV O(n^1.43)
Q(x)Q(−x)=V(x²)，U 分偶奇部，N 每輪減半，O(M(n) log N)
de Moraes et al., Parallelism in the Generation of Concepts Through Formal Context Object Partitioning (In-Close 4, OpenMP)
以物件子脈絡切分工作單元；4 threads 最高 1.425× speedup、71% 效率；冗餘屬性先移除
Bastioni–Micheli–Zhao, On the Characteristic Polynomial of Linearized Polynomials
O(n(log n)^4) F_q 運算，對低次線性化多項式達平方根級改進
Krajca–Outrata–Vychodil, Parallel CbO / FCbO canonicity test
改進 canonicity test 減少重複概念；同層 fixpoints 可平行處理
